mapper.select: SELECT N.MEMO_ID, N.POSITION_X, N.POSITION_Y, N.STACK_ORDER FROM BOARD_NODE N INNER JOIN MEMO M ON M.MEMO_ID = N.MEMO_ID INNER JOIN MEMO_FOLDER F ON F.FOLDER_ID = M.FOLDER_ID WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY N.STACK_ORDER ASC, N.MEMO_ID ASC

SELECT N.MEMO_ID, N.POSITION_X, N.POSITION_Y, N.STACK_ORDER FROM BOARD_NODE N INNER JOIN MEMO M ON M.MEMO_ID = N.MEMO_ID INNER JOIN MEMO_FOLDER F ON F.FOLDER_ID = M.FOLDER_ID WHERE N.MEMO_ID = #{memoId} AND F.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO BOARD_NODE TARGET USING ( SELECT M.MEMO_ID FROM MEMO M INNER JOIN MEMO_FOLDER F ON F.FOLDER_ID = M.FOLDER_ID WHERE M.MEMO_ID = #{node.memoId} AND F.USER_ID = #{userId} ) SOURCE ON ( TARGET.MEMO_ID = SOURCE.MEMO_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TARGET.POSITION_X = #{node.positionX}, TARGET.POSITION_Y = #{node.positionY}, TARGET.STACK_ORDER = #{node.stackOrder} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MEMO_ID, POSITION_X, POSITION_Y, STACK_ORDER ) VALUES ( SOURCE.MEMO_ID, #{node.positionX}, #{node.positionY}, #{node.stackOrder} )
